baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessed noun سَعْيَهُ is the subject matter of the future passive يُرَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Active work and earning are converted into an inspectable object; the verse promises manifestation of the person's operative endeavor, not merely notice that something happened.

activation_trace.role: Work, earning, and active conduct make the possessed sa'y a produced course of action rather than a wish.
Causing something to be seen supplies the conversion of private activity into presented evidence.

changed_reading.before: A person's deeds will eventually be noticed.
changed_reading.after: The person's active earning and conduct will be brought into view as an evidentiary object.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَعْيَهُ can name purposeful going, while يُرَىٰ places that movement within a future field of visibility.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object disclosed is not only a terminal result but a directed trajectory: movement, route, and orientation toward what was sought become visible.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful going supplies a path with direction and a sought endpoint.
Entering mutual visible range makes the traveled course confrontable rather than hidden behind its result.

changed_reading.before: Only the destination or outcome will be seen.
changed_reading.after: The person's directed movement toward the goal, including its route, will enter visible range.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future delay in سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ can hold a reflective rather than merely optical mode of seeing.
baseline_models.mechanism: Work is held for later considered judgment. The future seeing can therefore be an appraisal of what the endeavor meant, how it was directed, and what it actually accomplished.

activation_trace.role: Active work supplies the conduct that awaits assessment.
Reflective opinion and deliberative judgment turn future seeing into considered appraisal.

changed_reading.before: The future event is an optical replay of past deeds.
changed_reading.after: The future event is also a delayed, reflective assessment of the person's operative course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same يُرَىٰ inventory holds both ostentatious self-display and causative showing, while سَعْي can name noble undertakings.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive future removes control of visibility from the actor. A deed that looked noble because it was staged for observers is later shown under another agency, allowing genuine nobility and performance to separate.

activation_trace.role: Noble and peacemaking undertakings supply the socially honorable face an effort may claim.
Acting to be seen supplies the live possibility that apparent nobility is curated performance.
Being made visible by another agency reverses the actor's control over the display.

changed_reading.before: A publicly impressive undertaking validates itself by being visible.
changed_reading.after: The undertaking will be shown without the actor controlling the showing, exposing the difference between honor and display.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's movement from concealed communication to visible sign and manifested truth recasts the focus as an evidentiary conversion: inward or inaccessible work becomes a mark by which its reality can be established.

activation_trace.role: Work and active conduct supply the initially nonpublic process.
Making seen supplies the process by which conduct becomes evidence.
Knowledge cast in concealment supplies the hidden starting state of the surah's epistemic movement.
A manifest sign supplies the visible trace into which hidden reality can be converted.
Establishing and manifesting truth turns the visible trace into reality-testing evidence.

structural_cues: 53:4 presents communication in concealment, while 53:18 names manifest signs.
53:28 contrasts conjecture with reality shortly before the focus sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden knowledge, a manifest sign, and truth made evident; I infer that the same hidden-to-evident arrow organizes the person's work in 53:40. A live alternative is simple future observation without an evidentiary transformation.

changed_reading.before: The effort is merely watched later.
changed_reading.after: The effort is converted from an inaccessible process into a manifest sign capable of establishing what was real.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prohibition on self-purification and the repeated claim of superior knowing sharpen the passive future: true effort does not need actor-managed publicity, and staged visibility cannot settle its value.

activation_trace.role: Noble undertakings supply the kind of conduct most susceptible to honor claims.
Ostentatious action supplies self-curated visibility as the rival mechanism.
Causative showing relocates disclosure outside the actor's management.
Purity and rectitude supply the favorable status that people are told not to certify for themselves.
Disclosure to the knower supplies an epistemic standard independent of self-presentation.

structural_cues: 53:32 places the ban on self-purification beside repeated assertions of who knows best.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rectitude, ostentatious seeing, causative showing, and knowledge independent of the actor; I infer that passive disclosure displaces self-certification. The alternative is that 53:40 promises visibility without commenting on self-display.

changed_reading.before: A person can make good effort count by making it look good now.
changed_reading.after: The effort's decisive visibility arrives outside self-advertisement and can expose the gap between genuine striving and performed goodness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nontransferable burden, the immediately repeated sa'y, and the possessive suffix in سَعْيَهُ form an attribution chain. Disclosure preserves who generated the effort before any evaluation occurs.

activation_trace.role: Work and earning supply personally generated conduct that can bear attribution.
Making the conduct seen preserves its attribution in an inspectable form.
The heavy burden supplies the personally borne liability that cannot simply move to another carrier.
The repeated work-and-earning image immediately assigns the human share to what that human actually did.

structural_cues: 53:38 denies transfer of another's burden; 53:39 limits the human claim to what the human strove; 53:40 marks the effort with -hu.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a nontransferable load and repeated personally possessed work; I infer that future visibility functions as an attribution seal. The alternative is that nontransferability governs only punishment, not the disclosure process itself.

changed_reading.before: An undifferentiated stock of deeds becomes visible.
changed_reading.after: Each course of effort becomes visible with its generator still attached, resisting transfer, proxy, or borrowed credit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus becomes a procedural hinge. Work is first made inspectable; only then is action met with its counterpart and paid out without deficiency, so disclosure and recompense are distinct operations.

activation_trace.role: Work and earning provide the substantive input to the sequence.
Making the work seen supplies a disclosure stage before settlement.
Intentional action supplies the earlier labor whose consequences enter the accounting sequence.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the settlement operation after seeing.
Completion without deficiency specifies the settlement as full rather than approximate.

structural_cues: The immediate 53:39-41 order is possession of striving, future disclosure, then full recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies work, causative showing, matched recompense, and completeness; I infer a process order in which disclosure establishes the case before settlement. A live alternative treats 53:40 and 53:41 as parallel future assertions with no procedural distinction.

changed_reading.before: Being seen is itself the reward or punishment.
changed_reading.after: Being shown is the evidentiary stage that precedes a separate, fully matched settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Falling, appetite-driven inclination, an extended path, and a terminal limit turn sa'y into directional dynamics. What becomes visible is whether motion tracked a way, pitched into a fall, or was bent by desire, together with where it ended.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful going supplies directed motion toward a sought object.
Entry into visible range makes the motion's orientation confrontable.
Falling into a depth supplies one possible downward vector for motion.
The self's inclination supplies an internal force capable of bending the trajectory.
An extended traversable path supplies the route against which direction can be assessed.
The limit at which a thing ends supplies the trajectory's terminal coordinate.

structural_cues: The surah opens with descent, repeatedly opposes desire and guidance, and places the ultimate endpoint just after recompense.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purposeful motion, falling, inclination, path, and endpoint; I infer a vector model in which future seeing reveals direction as well as quantity. The alternative is that these spatial images remain separate and the focus concerns deeds without trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The amount of effort alone will be visible.
changed_reading.after: The effort's vector, deviations, path, and endpoint will be visible alongside its amount.

context_deltas.mechanism: The specialized sa'y of earning toward manumission meets the surah's servant and worship frame. Endeavor can be heard as labor whose eventual showing discloses whether it moved a person out of one mastery and into accountable service.

activation_trace.role: A bonded person's earnings toward release supply a concrete labor-to-freedom mechanism.
Making the labor seen turns an otherwise private accumulation into demonstrated progress.
Bondage and ownership supply the social condition from which manumission labor begins.
Submissive worship supplies the surah's closing form of service, distinct from human ownership.

structural_cues: The surah names a servant near the concealed communication and closes by commanding worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal bonded labor toward manumission, ownership, and worshipful service; I supply the arrow from disclosed labor to release from rival mastery. The live alternative is the dominant, nonspecialized sense of ordinary work.

changed_reading.before: Sa'y is neutral effort later displayed.
changed_reading.after: Sa'y may also be labor accumulating toward release, whose disclosure shows movement out of imposed mastery and toward chosen service.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of pregnancy becoming visible joins the later drop and gestational emergence. Effort can seed consequences that remain internally developing until they show before their full new arising.

activation_trace.role: Active conduct supplies the causal seed whose effects develop over time.
Pregnancy becoming visibly apparent supplies a deferred manifestation before completed emergence.
The generative drop supplies a minute beginning whose later consequence exceeds its first visibility.
Conception and the growth of pregnancy supply the latent developmental interval.

structural_cues: 53:45-47 moves from paired creation through a generative drop to another arising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a generative drop, gestational growth, and pregnancy becoming visible; I analogically assign effort the role of seed and future seeing the role of first manifestation. The alternative is that the creation sequence does not redescribe the focus at all.

changed_reading.before: Effort is immediately legible once performed.
changed_reading.after: Effort may incubate causal consequences that become visible only after a hidden developmental interval and before full emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exhausted exertion and the absence of a remainder separate effort from surviving product. Future showing preserves the spent process as knowable even when history leaves no material result behind.

activation_trace.role: Work and active exertion supply process that can be expended independently of success.
Making the process seen preserves it as evidence after its products disappear.
Consumption and exhaustion of effort supply labor spent until nothing usable remains.
The remainder branch supplies the material residue explicitly denied in the destruction sequence.

structural_cues: 53:50-51 narrates destruction followed by no remainder, after 53:40 has promised visibility to the effort itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhausted exertion and nonremaining residue; I infer that showing the effort preserves process-level evidence when outcome-level evidence has vanished. The alternative is that the destruction account has no bearing on whether failed effort is retained.

changed_reading.before: Only achievement that leaves a result can be shown.
changed_reading.after: Expended and apparently resultless effort remains showable even when no external residue survives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The critique of unsupported names activates name-as-indication and a visible identifying mark. Shown striving can become the person's truthful marker, replacing labels asserted without operative evidence.

activation_trace.role: Noble undertakings supply conduct capable of bearing a person's earned repute.
A flag erected to be seen supplies a public identifying marker for the disclosed effort.
A name as announcement and indication supplies the label whose truth-value is in question.
A visible mark that makes its bearer known supplies evidence-based identity in place of a bare label.

structural_cues: 53:23 dismisses inherited naming without authority; 53:40 later promises that personally possessed striving will be shown.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies names as indicators, visible identifying marks, and a visible flag; I infer that disclosed striving can function as an earned name. The alternative is that names and effort remain unrelated domains.

changed_reading.before: Effort is a private object eventually inspected.
changed_reading.after: Shown effort can become the person's public identifying mark, while unsupported names lose their claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protective covering and disclosure to a knower coexist in the same context. Thus being seen need not entail indiscriminate public exposure: accountable discernment of effort can coexist with merciful concealment of the person.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight allows visibility to range from public optics to discerning perception.
Making seen retains a real disclosure event while leaving its audience unspecified.
Covering fault and protecting its bearer supplies concealment that is preservative rather than deceptive.
A thing becoming disclosed to the knower supplies complete discernment without requiring universal publication.

structural_cues: 53:32 holds expansive forgiveness, divine knowing, and the refusal of self-certification in one unit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective covering and disclosure to a knower; I infer that accountability can reveal effort at the proper evaluative level without exposing everything to everyone. The competing reading remains a fully public showing.

changed_reading.before: Future seeing means universal public exposure.
changed_reading.after: The effort can be fully known and made evaluatively visible while protective concealment of the person still operates.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ر ء ي to ر و ي mapping and crosses sight into transmission; it remains anchored to يُرَىٰ and is independently activated by the later حديث branches. Render it only as an echo of narratability, not as a replacement translation for seeing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus token يُرَىٰ carries a packet-resolved non-dominant ر و ي inventory alongside its dominant seeing inventory.

activation_trace.role: Work and active conduct supply the life material that can later enter report.
Relaying reports and poetry shifts future visibility into transmissible account while staying attached to the focus token.
Speech renewed as report supplies the medium through which disclosed effort can circulate.
Becoming the talk of people supplies the social afterlife of an effort made narratable.

changed_reading.before: The effort will become optically observable.
changed_reading.after: The effort may also become narratable: converted into a report that can be retained and socially transmitted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the non-dominant س ع ي to س و ع mapping of neglected wandering; it remains anchored to سَعْيَهُ and gains a coherent counterforce from spacious forgiveness. Render it as a possibility for apparently wasted motion, never as the lexical center of sa'y.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sa'y has a packet-resolved non-dominant branch of being left to wander and go to waste.

activation_trace.role: Neglect and wandering loose supply effort that appears directionless, abandoned, or wasted.
Making seen prevents apparently wasted motion from disappearing without disclosure.
Expansiveness against constriction supplies room in which failed or wandering motion can still be held.
Protective covering of fault supplies mercy without denying that the wandering effort is known.

changed_reading.before: Only coherent, successful striving qualifies for future visibility.
changed_reading.after: Even energy that wandered, was neglected, or seemed wasted may be disclosed without falling outside spacious, protective mercy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy depends on the non-dominant ج ز ي to ج ز ز mapping and is therefore branch-distant; it remains anchored by focus work, causative showing, and the immediately following complete recompense. Render it as ripening or harvest imagery, not as a claim that jazāʾ literally means cutting here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places active work in view immediately before a packet branch for the time of cutting at maturity.

activation_trace.role: Work and earning supply what develops toward a yield.
Making the work seen supplies the sign that its yield has become available.
The season of cutting when growth is mature supplies a harvest threshold after manifestation.
Undiminished completion supplies the full yield gathered at that threshold.

changed_reading.before: Effort is displayed and then mechanically paid.
changed_reading.after: Display may mark ripeness: effort becomes visibly ready for a complete harvest of consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This forensic inversion uses the specialized sa'y of denouncing someone to authority, so it is narrower than ordinary endeavor; it remains anchored to the focus noun and gains packet support from authority-as-proof and truth made manifest. Render it as one possible exposure of accusatory agency, not the verse's default legal sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sa'y inventory includes tale-bearing or denunciation to a ruler, and the passive seeing can turn scrutiny back onto that activity.

activation_trace.role: Denunciation to authority supplies an accusatory action whose agent may expect only the target to be scrutinized.
Making the sa'y seen reverses scrutiny onto the informing activity itself.
Compelling proof supplies the evidentiary authority an accusation would need but may lack.
Manifesting truth supplies the test that distinguishes valid report from destructive tale-bearing.

changed_reading.before: The person's effort is simply an object of general observation.
changed_reading.after: Where the effort was an accusation against another, the informing act itself will be exposed and tested for proof.

strongest_changes: Future seeing became an evidentiary conversion from hidden conduct into a truth-testing sign.
The focus became a procedural hinge: attributed work is disclosed before it is fully recompensed.
The possessive effort became nontransferable, preserving the generator of both burden and credit.
Visibility split into competing modes: public marking, uncurated disclosure, reflective appraisal, and complete knowing compatible with protective covering.
Destroyed or resultless labor remained recoverable at the process level even when no external residue survived.
summary.what_was_special: The split inventories kept several live but contained activations that a conservative reading would lose: seeing becoming narration, sa'y becoming wandering or manumission labor, recompense becoming harvest, and visibility becoming gestational emergence or forensic reversal. These coexist with the strong work-evidence-recompense model rather than being merged into it.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive يُرَىٰ does not settle whether the primary mode is being seen, being shown, inward discernment, or public presentation.
The audience and scale of disclosure remain open: divine knowing, the actor's recognition, adjudicative inspection, and communal visibility can coexist but are not identical.
The narration, wandering, and harvest readings depend on non-dominant split mappings and must remain exploratory.
The immediate recompense sequence strongly suggests an evidentiary stage, but it may instead present parallel future events without a procedural order.
